msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia merceria-san-garcia-25.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of cakes of variegated cotton yarn in turquoise, cream and orange from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia merceria-san-garcia-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a hand-dyed skein of variegated wool yarn in red, green and orange autumn tones from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia merceria-san-garcia-27.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a hand-dyed skein of blue and grey wool yarn from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia merceria-san-garcia-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of cakes of soft yarn in pastel pink, coral, lilac and cream from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia merceria-san-garcia-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a cake of variegated cotton yarn in beige and brown from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#F1ECE5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
